Found six migration regressions: four inline findings and two below. The broad light review is complete, including affected initialization, checkpoint, inference and test paths. Tests were not executed; the checks below are proposed acceptance criteria. Suggested code must be verified before adoption.

### Preserve converted vocabulary in compatibility metadata

**Failure:** [The saver now updates only the tokenizer config](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/tools/checkpoint/saver_base.py#L391-L420), but [checkpoint serialization still saves legacy args](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/megatron/training/checkpointing.py#L1669-L1674). For example, the [HF Mixtral loader supplies `padded_vocab_size=32000`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/tools/checkpoint/loader_mixtral_hf.py#L48-L55). Conversion to TP=8 with divisibility 128 produces 32768-row weights/config, while saved `args.padded_vocab_size` remains 32000. [Loading with `--use-checkpoint-args` restores that stale value](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/megatron/training/checkpointing.py#L2501-L2507), constructing 4000-row shards for saved 4096-row shards and failing model-state loading. The base saver updated this compatibility field.

**Correction:** Keep repadding/model construction config-owned, but synchronize the legacy serialization contract. The smallest converter-local fix is this line after the imports and before saving in [save_local_models_to_checkpoint](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/tools/checkpoint/saver_base.py#L345-L367):

```python
self.margs.padded_vocab_size = self.cfg.tokenizer.padded_vocab_size
```

The invariant is that saved compatibility vocabulary describes the tensors being saved, not source-checkpoint padding.

**Preservation / acceptance:** Propose a round trip with 32000 source rows, TP=8 and divisibility 128: model, config and saved args must all describe 32768 rows; reloading with `--use-checkpoint-args` must load 4096 rows per shard. Also cover unchanged padding, trimming larger source padding, and `true_vocab_size=None` retaining the original row count. Preserve original token rows, final-row replication for added padding, and the target-derived parallelism assertions in [test_checkpoint_saver_target_args](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/tests/unit_tests/tools/checkpoint/test_checkpoint_saver_target_args.py#L13-L37).

### Migrate the existing MIMO mock-data test fixture too

**Failure:** [The mock loader now reads `cfg.tokenizer.vocab_size`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/examples/mimo/training/data.py#L386-L400), but [its existing test fixture](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/tests/unit_tests/models/mimo/test_mimo_mock_data.py#L71-L78) initializes only the config seed; vocabulary 64 remains solely in `_args()`. The shared run-config fixture leaves tokenizer vocabulary `None`, so the existing mock-loader tests now reach [`torch.arange(1, vocab_size)`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/examples/mimo/training/data.py#L95-L98) with `None` and fail before their assertions.

**Correction:** In that `adapter` fixture, immediately after setting the seed, add:

```python
run_config.tokenizer.vocab_size = 64
```

Do not restore an args fallback in production: the fixture must initialize the newly authoritative owner.

**Preservation / acceptance:** Propose a config-authority case with config vocabulary 64 and stale args vocabulary 96; generated text IDs must remain below 64 and exclude padding/image IDs. Retain the existing fixed-resolution batch-shape assertions, the dynamic RADIO `(1, 96, 192)` image tensor and packed-boundary assertions, CP-replica batch equality, and independent data-lane seeds in [the mock-data tests](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/tests/unit_tests/models/mimo/test_mimo_mock_data.py#L81-L200).

### Use the bound run-config variable throughout this provider

**Failure:** `model_provider()` binds `cfg_container`, not `cfg`. A valid fixed-resolution model build now raises `NameError` here. Dynamic-resolution builds bypass this line but fail at [the unconditional tile-tag call](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/examples/multimodal/model.py#L262-L270), even when tile tags are disabled. **Correction:** Use the existing run-config binding here:

```suggestion
            tokenizer_type=cfg_container.tokenizer.tokenizer_prompt_format,
```

Apply the same exact replacement to the prompt-format reads at lines 265 and 301. Do not use the optional `config` argument: that is a transformer config, not the run container. All tokenizer fields in this provider must come from `cfg_container.tokenizer`.

**Preservation / acceptance:** Propose provider tests with no module-global `cfg`, stubbing expensive model/config factories. With tile tags disabled, retain `tile_tags=None`; with tags enabled, retain the `nvlm-yi-34b` global tag and Nemotron zero-padded tile names selected by [the helper](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/examples/multimodal/model.py#L336-L368). These checks were not executed.

### Pass the MIMO provider's actual config binding

**Failure:** This provider initializes `cfg_container` at line 152, but no `cfg` exists locally or at module scope. Any otherwise valid MIMO checkpoint inference build with an image token ID reaches this constructor argument and raises `NameError` instead of constructing the mapped LLaVA model. [The inference dispatcher selects this provider for MIMO checkpoints](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/examples/inference/advanced/vlm_dynamic_inference.py#L480-L484).

**Correction:** Read the same container already used for language vocabulary:

```suggestion
        tokenizer_type=cfg_container.tokenizer.tokenizer_prompt_format,
```

**Preservation / acceptance:** Propose a provider test with no global `cfg`, a config tokenizer containing `padded_vocab_size=512` and prompt format `mistral`, valid hybrid/vision arguments, and `image_token_id=18`; stub the expensive constructor and assert it receives vocabulary 512, tokenizer type `mistral`, image index 18 and the supplied checkpoint-prefix map. Retain the explicit missing-image-token rejection and the sharded-key mapping assertion in [the existing MIMO inference tests](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/tests/unit_tests/inference/test_mimo_checkpoint_inference.py#L102-L117). Source reasoning only; tests were not run.

### Preserve the converter's vocabulary-file override

**Failure:** The converter's `--vocab-file` is parsed into `self.args` by [the loader CLI](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/tools/checkpoint/loader_core.py#L14-L23). It is not forwarded into the separate Megatron namespace by [build_sys_argv](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/tools/checkpoint/loader_base.py#L467-L490), from which `self.cfg` is constructed. Consequently, a three-entry converter vocabulary file now yields `compute_true_vocab_size()==None`, not 3; supplying `--true-vocab-size 4` with that file also incorrectly passes verification. The saver loses its explicit trimming input.

**Correction:** In `compute_true_vocab_size()` and `verify_vocabs_match()`, replace all four newly introduced `self.cfg.tokenizer.vocab_file` reads with `self.args.vocab_file`. This is a converter-protocol option, distinct from the training tokenizer's file. At this anchor:

```suggestion
        elif self.args.vocab_file is not None:
```

**Preservation / acceptance:** Propose isolated tests using a temporary three-entry JSON file and config tokenizer `vocab_file=None`: expect true size 3; verification with explicit size 3 must pass and size 4 must fail. With no converter file, explicit true size must still win; with neither option, retain `None` rather than implicitly using an unrelated training tokenizer file. Tests were not executed.

**Failure:** The new config-owned gate can enter when `cfg.tokenizer.vocab_file='vocab.json'` but legacy `args.vocab_file=None`. ### Use the bound run-config variable throughout this provider

**Failure:** `model_provider()` binds `cfg_container`, not `cfg`. A valid fixed-resolution model build now raises `NameError` here. Dynamic-resolution builds bypass this line but fail at [the unconditional tile-tag call](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/examples/multimodal/model.py#L262-L270), even when tile tags are disabled. This blocks both multimodal training and inference model construction.

**Correction:** Use the existing run-config binding here:

```suggestion
            tokenizer_type=cfg_container.tokenizer.tokenizer_prompt_format,
```

Apply the same exact replacement to the prompt-format reads at lines 265 and 301. Do not use the optional `config` argument: that is a transformer config, not the run container. All tokenizer fields in this provider must come from `cfg_container.tokenizer`.

**Preservation / acceptance:** Propose provider tests with no module-global `cfg`, stubbing expensive model/config factories. Both fixed and dynamic resolution must reach the model constructor with the config-owned padded vocabulary and prompt format, even when args contain different tokenizer values. With tile tags disabled, retain `tile_tags=None`; with tags enabled, retain the `nvlm-yi-34b` global tag and Nemotron zero-padded tile names selected by [the helper](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/examples/multimodal/model.py#L336-L368). These checks were not executed.

### Pass the MIMO provider's actual config binding

**Failure:** This provider initializes `cfg_container` at line 152, but no `cfg` exists locally or at module scope. Any otherwise valid MIMO checkpoint inference build with an image token ID reaches this constructor argument and raises `NameError` instead of constructing the mapped LLaVA model. [The inference dispatcher selects this provider for MIMO checkpoints](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/examples/inference/advanced/vlm_dynamic_inference.py#L480-L484).

**Correction:** Read the same container already used for language vocabulary:

```suggestion
        tokenizer_type=cfg_container.tokenizer.tokenizer_prompt_format,
```

**Preservation / acceptance:** Propose a provider test with no global `cfg`, a config tokenizer containing `padded_vocab_size=512` and prompt format `mistral`, valid hybrid/vision arguments, and `image_token_id=18`; stub the expensive constructor and assert it receives vocabulary 512, tokenizer type `mistral`, image index 18 and the supplied checkpoint-prefix map. Retain the explicit missing-image-token rejection and the sharded-key mapping assertion in [the existing MIMO inference tests](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/tests/unit_tests/inference/test_mimo_checkpoint_inference.py#L102-L117). Tests were not executed; the checks below are proposed acceptance criteria. Suggested code must be verified before adoption.

### Preserve converted vocabulary in compatibility metadata

**Failure:** [The saver now updates only the tokenizer config](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/tools/checkpoint/saver_base.py#L391-L420), but [checkpoint serialization still saves legacy args](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/megatron/training/checkpointing.py#L1669-L1674). For example, the [HF Mixtral loader supplies `padded_vocab_size=32000`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/tools/checkpoint/loader_mixtral_hf.py#L48-L55). Conversion to TP=8 with divisibility 128 produces 32768-row weights/config, while saved `args.padded_vocab_size` remains 32000. [Loading with `--use-checkpoint-args` restores that stale value](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/megatron/training/checkpointing.py#L2501-L2507), constructing 4000-row shards for saved 4096-row shards and failing model-state loading. The base saver updated this compatibility field.

**Correction:** Keep repadding/model construction config-owned, but synchronize the legacy serialization contract. The smallest converter-local fix is this line after the imports and before saving in [save_local_models_to_checkpoint](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/tools/checkpoint/saver_base.py#L345-L367):

```python
self.margs.padded_vocab_size = self.cfg.tokenizer.padded_vocab_size
```

The invariant is that saved compatibility vocabulary describes the tensors being saved, not source-checkpoint padding.

**Preservation / acceptance:** Propose a round trip with 32000 source rows, TP=8 and divisibility 128: model, config and saved args must all describe 32768 rows; reloading with `--use-checkpoint-args` must load 4096 rows per shard. Also cover unchanged padding, trimming larger source padding, and `true_vocab_size=None` retaining the original row count. Preserve original token rows, final-row replication for added padding, and the target-derived parallelism assertions in [test_checkpoint_saver_target_args](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/tests/unit_tests/tools/checkpoint/test_checkpoint_saver_target_args.py#L13-L37).

### Migrate the existing MIMO mock-data test fixture too

**Failure:** [The mock loader now reads `cfg.tokenizer.vocab_size`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/examples/mimo/training/data.py#L386-L400), but [its existing test fixture](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/tests/unit_tests/models/mimo/test_mimo_mock_data.py#L71-L78) initializes only the config seed; vocabulary 64 remains solely in `_args()`. The shared run-config fixture leaves tokenizer vocabulary `None`, so the existing mock-loader tests now reach [`torch.arange(1, vocab_size)`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/examples/mimo/training/data.py#L95-L98) with `None` and fail before their assertions.

**Correction:** In that `adapter` fixture, immediately after setting the seed, add:

```

Do not restore an args fallback in production: the fixture must initialize the newly authoritative owner.

Retain the existing fixed-resolution batch-shape assertions, the dynamic RADIO `(1, 96, 192)` image tensor and packed-boundary assertions, CP-replica batch equality, and independent data-lane seeds in [the mock-data tests](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/95e892c25497cbfa7fa690a2852ee912b73d7c0e/tests/unit_tests/models/mimo/test_mimo_mock_data.py#L81-L200).
